findings.evidence: Lines 54–66 require an involutive antihomomorphism on every `g : G`, while the cited criterion states `φ : Δ → Δ`, `φ(Γ)=Γ`, and `ΓαΓ=Γφ(α)Γ`; `IsHeckeTriple.left_le` already supplies `H ≤ Δ`.
findings.fix: Define the anti-involution on `Δ` (with preservation of `H`, using `IsHeckeTriple.left_le`) and refactor the transport proof to establish that each barred expression belongs to `Δ`, or weaken the theorem’s attribution and document that it proves only an extension-dependent special case.
findings.issue: `HeckeAntiInvolution.toFun : G →* Gᵐᵒᵖ` over-strengthens Shimura’s hypothesis, which only requires an anti-involution `Δ → Δ`; thus the declarations advertised as Shimura’s criterion exclude valid Hecke data whose anti-involution does not extend to G.

summary: The formalized criterion is strictly narrower than Shimura’s cited criterion because it requires the anti-involution to extend from Δ to the entire ambient group G.
